description.text: Objectives Objective of the program in Computer Science and Technology aims to provide students with solid theory as well as the latest technological knowledge. Research methods and communication skills are taught while team works are encouraged. After the program, students should be able to engage in high level research and assume leadership role in their respective fields. Duration Duration of the program is 2-2.5 years with course works in the first year, followed by a thesis project. Research Areas 1. Computer Application Techniques 2. Pattern Recognition and Intelligent System 3. Computer Software Theory 4. Information Security Credit Units Students need to successfully complete at least 29 credit units. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Harbin Institute of Technology is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/In total ￥ 35000 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1. HITSZ International Student Application Form 2. Highest degree (notarized photocopy) 3. Academic transcripts (notarized photocopy) 4. A study plan (no less than 800 words) 5. Three recommendation letters 6. Photocopy of your Identification Certificate 7. Three passport photos

requirements.text: 1. Aged 18 or above 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health. 3. Hold a Bachelor's degree.
